notes: Repo under test is the Adobe Experience League 'exlm' EDS project (Universal Editor authoring). Merged skill: catalog/discovery + change tracking, fuzzy id resolution, conditional-field handling, dual-audience guides (MD + docx).

evals.name: catalog-discovery
evals.prompt: What blocks can I use in our EDS project at C:\Users\hcl40471\AppData\Local\Temp\exlm-repo? Show me the list.
evals.expected_output: Runs blocks.js catalog and presents a numbered Title (id) — Group list of all blocks. If a snapshot exists, leads with NEW/UPDATED and says how many changed; on first run notes there's no change history yet.
expectations: The catalog was produced via the blocks.js engine (not hand-parsed JSON).
The response lists blocks as 'Title (id) — Group' and covers the full set (~130+).
NEW/UPDATED blocks are surfaced first with a count, or first-run is noted.

evals.name: detailed-teaser-conditional-fields
evals.prompt: Write an authoring guide for the detailed-teaser block in C:\Users\hcl40471\AppData\Local\Temp\exlm-repo, as markdown and a Word doc. Make sure authors understand which fields only show up sometimes.
evals.expected_output: A .md and .docx dual-audience guide. The Authoring section flags conditional fields with 'Shown only when …' (e.g. First CTA Background Color shown only when First CTA Type is Custom). Variants cover Theme/Alignment/Background Color; Technical reference maps fields to DOM.
expectations: A Markdown guide and a valid .docx were created.
Conditional fields are flagged with a 'shown only when' note (e.g. CTA Background Color when CTA Type is Custom).
Contains all four sections and the field->DOM technical mapping.
The Variants section documents the Theme, Alignment, and Background Color style groups.

evals.name: fuzzy-block-name
evals.prompt: document the 'detaild teaser' block for authors (repo C:\Users\hcl40471\AppData\Local\Temp\exlm-repo) — md + docx
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the misspelling via fuzzy suggestions from blocks.js (detailed-teaser), confirms/uses the right block, and produces the guide pair.
expectations: The misspelled id is resolved to detailed-teaser using the engine's fuzzy suggestions.
A Markdown guide and a valid .docx were created for detailed-teaser.
